requirements.scope: Independent panes, history, parent entries, roots, path editing, tabs, closed-tab restoration, refresh and keyboard access
MC Insert behavior, ranges, all/none/inverse and wildcard masks, preserving marks and excluding the parent entry
Correct pane/selection targets, keyboard-accessible context and command menus, focus restoration, edge positioning and both themes
Copy, cut and paste across panes and supported sources; local Windows file clipboard interoperability with Explorer; copy paths
Copy/move/delete/rename, conflicts, cancellation, partial failures, metadata handling and source/destination preservation
Add, rename, remove and use bookmarks and saved places with keyboard access and persistent configuration
Explorer network locations, custom UNC entries, mapped drives, server/share navigation and errors
SSH config catalog, credentials, key verification, reconnect/disconnect behavior, realistic config directives, independent sessions and transfers
Multiple tunnels, persistence, start/stop/remove, conflicts and connection lifecycle
Local and remote interactive shells, Ctrl+O, docking, independent persistent sessions, resize and lifecycle
Practical text/image/PDF viewing, search/navigation, copy, zoom, large-file behavior and keyboard controls
Create/edit/save/save-as, encoding and line endings, search/replace, undo/redo, selection/indentation and unsaved-change protection including application close
Names and masks, recursive filters, useful content search, results navigation, progress/cancellation and error reporting
Practical common archive workflows, safe browsing/creation/extraction, path and symlink protection, and explicit format limitations
Inspect useful file/folder metadata and applicable permissions/attributes without destructive shortcuts
Preview and act on useful differences between the two panes, with review before synchronization or replacement
Dark/light/system themes, density, translucency, menus, controls, dialogs, tooltips, language completeness, focus visibility and supported window sizes
Practical shortcuts for all implemented actions, searchable F1 help, accurate tooltips, no context collisions or accidental browser reloads
Settings migration/validation, tabs and remote history, external config changes, interrupted operations and useful recovery errors
Matching Windows builds, current installer and executable, integration checks, English documentation and screenshots, release provenance
